_comment: Bundle distribution manifest (U-44). Declares the two distributable bundle variants — 'core' (open-source) and 'commercial' (full deployment). Consumed by autopilot/lib/bundle-variants.mjs to detect the active variant at runtime and enforce feature-flag availability.

core.description: Open-source core bundle — the reusable agent-workflow engine with no project-specific bindings. Distribute or open-source this layer freely.

commercial.description: Full commercial bundle — core engine plus project-specific bindings in commercial/. Config is read from commercial/config.json (preferred) with root config.json as fallback.

multiWorkspace.description: Run the engine against multiple workspace targets simultaneously (workspaces.json). Enabled when workspaces.json exists alongside config.json.

budgetGovernor.description: Pre-cycle deterministic token-budget gate (lib/budget-governor.mjs). Prevents overspend before it happens. Enable with budgetGovernor.enabled:true in config.json.

keyPooling.description: API key pool rotation (lib/key-manager.mjs). Round-robins multiple accounts, rotates off rate-limited ones. Enable by populating api_pools[] in config.json.

architectMode.description: Stage-2 Architect Mode — macro-vision prompt decomposition via the premium tier. Enable with architect.enabled:true in config.json.

contextProvider.description: External codebase-context seam (core/context-provider.mjs). Lets a host pre-compute file/symbol/dependency indexes for the selector. Enable with contextProvider.enabled:true and set contextProvider.source.

providerRouting.description: Per-role model-provider routing (core/providers.mjs). Route different agent roles to different LLM providers (Anthropic, OpenRouter, custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint). Configure via providers.definitions + providers.roleMap in config.json.

commercialProfile.description: Project-specific workspace profile (profiles/<name>.json). Supplies the curated backlog seed, task-selection filters, and implementer prompt conventions for a commercial deployment. Set config.json → profile to a profile name in profiles/.
